verdict.rationale: Square's developer docs include a dedicated Webhooks section with a 'Subscribe to Event Notifications' step and a 'Verify and Validate an Event Notification' guide for signature checking. Webhook event logs are also referenced alongside API Logs, so the core subscribe-to-events capability is first-party documented. Missing for 10: detail on the event-type catalog, delivery/retry semantics, and programmatic subscription management (the evidence is mostly page titles), plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
